nativeUiTimeline.observedGuestCopy: Guest; Your progress stays on this device. Sign in or create an account to sync and restore it.
nativeUiTimeline.baselineComparison: The preserved pre-fixture screenshot at docs/active/AUD-08/evidence/B3/native/aud08-b3-010-settings-guest-account-cta.png shows the same Guest identity, device-local progress copy, sign-in CTA and Progress tab. The post-exit flow asserted the same copy/CTA and opened the Progress root.

scopedBackendRevoke.uiAndSdkProved: Account sign-out completed into signed-out/login UI; account.signOut verifies auth.getSnapshot() is null before publishing signedOut. Continue without account then entered guest Home.
scopedBackendRevoke.remoteRevocationStatus: not performed or verified during this flow
scopedBackendRevoke.clientContract: signOut persists a local UID/operationId block in LocalLogoutControl, closes account profile storage, then calls Firebase Auth signOut. It does not call revokeSessions in this path. Pending revoke is drained on a later same-UID authenticated restore/sign-in.
scopedBackendRevoke.serverScope: POST /v1/account/session/revoke is bound to the authenticated userId, expected authorization generation and operationId; server route/store sources are patternly-backend/src/api/app.ts and src/modules/account-lifecycle/store.ts.
scopedBackendRevoke.whyNotTriggered: No same-UID sign-in followed guest return; doing so would leave the verified guest state and trigger an additional Auth lifecycle. No manual revoke endpoint call was made.

guestStorage.interpretation: The encrypted store remains present at its original size, but ciphertext changes across Auth/recovery state transitions. Guest identity, local-progress copy, account-entry CTA, and Progress UI are present after exit. Without the excluded Keychain encryption key, this does not establish byte-level or record-level equality with the backup.
